mapper.select: SELECT mta.*, u.real_name AS teacher_name FROM marking_task_assign mta LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON mta.teacher_id = u.id WHERE mta.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY mta.marking_role, mta.create_time

SELECT mta.*, u.real_name AS teacher_name, mt.name AS task_name, e.name AS exam_name, es.subject_name AS subject_name, pq.question_no, mt.status AS task_status FROM marking_task_assign mta LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON mta.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN marking_task mt ON mta.task_id = mt.id LEFT JOIN exam e ON mt.exam_id = e.id LEFT JOIN exam_subject es ON mt.exam_subject_id = es.id LEFT JOIN paper_question pq ON mt.question_id = pq.id WHERE mta.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND mt.status = 1 AND mt.deleted = 0 ORDER BY mta.create_time DESC
